channel.title: Repo, Explained
channel.description: One trending GitHub repo, explained visually. Every day. Fully automated.

item.title: How anydoc knows what a file really is before converting it to Markdown
item.description: Firecrawl's anydoc converts Word, Excel, PowerPoint, PDF and more to clean Markdown in ~5ms of pure Rust. The best part is its spec-driven format detection, which identifies files by their contents instead of trusting extensions.

item.title: How QM switches agent vendors mid-conversation without losing history
item.description: QM is a self-hosted 'multiplayer agent harness' that gives every employee an isolated agent workspace on Slack and the web — and lets an org swap Pi, Codex, or Claude Code under the same sessions.

item.title: How Kimi K3 serves 2.8 trillion parameters by waking up only 104 billion
item.description: Moonshot AI released full weights for Kimi K3, the first open model in the 3-trillion-parameter class. A hybrid linear-attention stack, extreme MoE sparsity, and native 4-bit training make the size actually deployable.
